items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Body text with size, weight and tone props, tabular numerals, and single-line truncate or multi-line lineClamp. Clipped text stays fully in the DOM and exposed through title.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. v4 migration: new `expandable` prop (with `lineClamp`): a 24 px `aria-expanded` button row is always reserved below the text and is visibility-hidden while the text fits, so unclamped text gains a 24 px empty row when `expandable` is on. `Text` now accepts a `ref`.
